1.name: Investigator
1.body: The foundation line — needs to know, research, go deep. Insecurity shows up without a solid base; the strength is conviction earned through deep study.

2.name: Hermit
2.body: Natural talent that surfaces without effort, but needs solo time to refuel. Others see the talent before the Hermit does; when called at the right moment, it comes out.

3.name: Martyr
3.body: Learns through direct trial and error. Lots of "I tried that, here's what happened" — that's not failure, that's how this line finds accurate knowledge through experience.

4.name: Opportunist
4.body: Lives life through close networks — friends, family, inner circle. Opportunities and information arrive through people you already know, not from broadcasting outward.

5.name: Heretic
5.body: A solution-bringer that others project onto. High expectations come from outside — sometimes fair, sometimes not. When the delivery is real, the impact reaches far.

6.name: Role Model
6.body: Three life phases: trial-error (0–30), up on the roof to observe (30–50), back down as role model (50+). Not having the answers, but holding the wisdom of experience.
